name: frame
title: Image frame
description: Mounts a photo so it feels like an object, with an optional caption.

props.name: alt
props.demo: A pine tree on a rock in a still pool, inside a concrete courtyard in the rain
props.description: Describes the photo. Use an empty string when it is only decoration.

props.name: caption
props.description: A short line under the photo. Leave it empty for none.

props.name: ratio
props.description: 4 by 3, 1 by 1 or 3 by 4. The photo is cropped to fit.
